From discovery to validation, every phase informed the next ensuring design decisions were driven by user needs, product strategy, and long-term scalability rather than visual execution alone.

Social platforms let creators build huge audiences but give them little control over who reaches them or how their time is valued. Social DMs are asynchronous and noisy. Clubhouse-style rooms are group-based and unmonetized for individuals. Cameo is pre-recorded, with no real-time interaction. There is no dedicated space for controlled, intentional, fee-based one-on-one voice conversations with verification and proximity-based discovery.

For Users Comment sections feel impersonal; users want real, direct access to creators they follow, with transparent pricing and no hidden subscriptions. For Creators Hundreds of daily messages and unpaid advice requests make it hard to find genuine requests, protect privacy, and monetize their time beyond brand deals. For Existing Platforms Products solve either broadcast reach or recorded personalization, but none offer verified, real-time, creator-controlled conversations.
Creators increasingly monetize expertise and attention, yet no product treats a live conversation as a premium, protected experience. Cirqell explores that gap.
Creators earn fairly for every minute of their time.
Voice feels more authentic than text and more personal than pre-recorded video.
Creators set pricing, availability, and who can reach them.
